en: Soldier: head yellow, the capsule elongate; fontanelle a small circular pit; labrum short and setose. Mandibles stout and sabre-like, the left one bearing a triangular tooth at mid-length, the right with a corresponding small tooth. Antennae fourteen segmented, the third segment shorter than the second. Pronotum saddle-shaped with a shallow median incision. Alate: body brown, eyes oval and prominent, ocelli close to the compound eyes; wings with the median vein arising from the shoulder suture. Recorded from southern China in dead wood; the biology is little known.
soldier: 头褐黄，前胸背板暗黄。头部生短毛，以前部略密。头壳长方形，两侧缘平行，后缘宽圆。囟呈小圆点状，略微隆起。上唇为宽舌形，最宽处在中点之前，宽度大于长度。上颚粗壮而直，颚端稍弯，颚基的峰状隆起不显。触角十四节。后颏的腰区狭长，后颏长度约为其宽度的二点八至二点九倍，约为腰区最狭处的七点四七至七点五八倍。前胸背板肾形，宽度约为中长的两倍，前缘以宽V形深凹，两侧缘与后缘连成宽阔的弧形，后缘中央微凹，中区生毛约十根。
